unit.why: A short biographical-genealogical entry on R. Yehuda Leibush of Rozdol (his marriage to the daughter of R. Zevi of Zhidachov, his burial in his brother-in-law's tomb, and their brotherly love and equal sharing of the rabbinate and household clothing); it describes relations and customs but narrates no event or plot.
unit.boundary_note: entry opens the section 'מערכת י. דודינו הרה"ק ר׳ יודא ליבוש מראזלא' begun at the end of the previous division; next division starts a new entry on a grandson of R. Yehuda Zevi
